featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited your Mulund RHB Road branch for the bleach, facial, and waxing package, and since it was my first visit, I was quite hopeful. Seeing a good crowd, I felt reassured that I had chosen the right place where many people trust your services. However, my experience turned out to be quite disappointing.

1. Waxing:
I informed the beautician, Asha, that the wax felt too hot, yet she continued without adjusting it. The waxing was done unevenly and in random patches, and I had to repeatedly point out areas that were left undone. Additionally, the waxing machine was unhygienic, with visible hair stuck around the edges — even after I mentioned it, she ignored my request to clean it.

2. Bleach:
I had clearly mentioned that I wanted a golden tone and not to overdo it, but there was no visible effect after the bleach. When I pointed out that the facial hair was still black, Asha insisted it looked golden. I then asked her colleague Mamta to check, and she confirmed that the bleach hadn’t been done properly. Only then were certain patches re-applied.

3. Facial:
I opted for a skin whitening facial, but it was very uncomfortable. The pressure during the massage was excessive, and her nails scratched my skin a few times. Facials are supposed to be relaxing, but this felt rough and unpleasant — almost like kneading dough rather than a facial massage.

Additional note:
At the beginning, Asha mentioned she had a nerve issue in her finger. I appreciated her honesty and empathized with her, but I now feel that it may have affected the quality of her service.

While I have no personal grudge against Asha or Jyotsana, I am genuinely disappointed with the overall experience — especially since it was my first visit. I had high expectations based on your reputation, but unfortunately, I wouldn’t recommend this branch to others based on my experience.

I hope this feedback is taken constructively to help improve service quality, staff attentiveness, and hygiene standards.
